description: Compiles and runs Q0614BA (06-14b: DATE/NULL handling, ALWNULL(*USRCTL) ctl-opt + NULLIND D-spec keyword + %nullind, bridged to a separate SQL indicator host variable for FETCH). Per the design's own requirement, this program creates its own QTEMP-scoped work table (W0614BA, a reduced TOKUIM copy plus one NULL-capable date column) via embedded CREATE TABLE and never touches the shared sample-DB schema - confirmed as the ONLY Part 6 lesson whose object lives entirely in QTEMP, so no TXRESET dependency applies here. Since QTEMP is job-scoped, this only works because verify/lib/clgen.mjs's cl steps all run inside one single wrapper job (confirmed in part06-01-cvtrpgsrc's manifest description) - the CREATE TABLE and the later CALL both happen in that same job, so QTEMP/W0614BA survives between them. Reports via QSYSPRT, captured as spooled-file text.

steps.label: VSPLPF
steps.cmd:
CHKOBJ OBJ(&LIB/VFYSPL) OBJTYPE(*FILE)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF9801) EXEC(CRTPF FILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) RCDLEN(133) TEXT('Part 6 spooled-file text capture'))

steps.label: CPQ0614BA
steps.cmd: CRTSQLRPGI OBJ(&LIB/Q0614BA) SRCFILE(&LIB/QRPGLESRC) SRCMBR(Q0614BA) OBJTYPE(*PGM) COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: RUNQ0614BA
steps.cmd:
CALL PGM(&LIB/Q0614BA)
CPYSPLF FILE(Q0614BA) TOFILE(&LIB/VFYSPL) SPLNBR(*LAST) JOB(*) CTLCHAR(*NONE) MBROPT(*ADD)
